_comment: STING corporate Drawing Types. Override per project by dropping a drawing_types.json under <project>/_BIM_COORD/. Project entries win by id; routing rules from the project file are PREPENDED (first-match-wins).

_tokenProfileDesign.rationale: Each drawingType.tokenProfile is precomputed for Phase 165 by the matrix in commit message 'Intelligent tag profile matrix'. Override any field per project by dropping a project-scoped drawing_types.json under <project>/_BIM_COORD/.
rules: PRESENTATION (pres-*) — ITALIC GREY 2.5mm, Mono scheme, depth 2, PROD-SEQ display, identity+spatial sections only. Subdued for client-facing decks.
CLARIFICATION (clar-*) — BOLDITALIC RED 3mm, Discipline scheme, depth 3, full 8-segment, A+B+C+D+F sections. Markup style for RFIs / queries.
HANDOVER / FM (handover, fm-*) — NOM PURPLE 2.5mm, System scheme, depth 10, HANDOVER pattern, T4+T9+T10 tiers active. Lifecycle-ready audit trail.
SPOOL / FABRICATION (-spool, -fabrication) — BOLD BLACK 3mm, System scheme, depth 7, DISC-PROD-SEQ display, T7 fab+QC tier. Workshop-readable.
SCHEDULE (-schedule) — NOM 2mm, BOQ preset, depth 1, no graphic scheme, PROD-SEQ display. Schedules render as tables.
COORDINATION / CLASH (coord-, clash-) — BOLD RED 2.5mm, Discipline scheme, depth 8, T8 clash triage tier. Highlights ownership.
LEGEND — NOM GREY 2mm, Compact preset, depth 1, SEQ-only display. Legend tags read like keys.
FIRE STRATEGY / FIRE ALARM (-fire-) — BOLD RED 2.5mm, System scheme, depth 4, T4 commissioning tier. Witness/sign-off captured.
DEMOLITION — BOLD RED, Status scheme, depth 2. Status colours show NEW/EXISTING/DEMOLISHED.
FINISHES (-finishes, -screed, -raised-floor) — Status scheme, depth 3. Each finish package reads distinctly.
SETTING OUT — BOLD, depth 4, Discipline scheme. Survives crowded annotation.
SITE / ACCESSIBILITY — Zone scheme, depth 3. Reads compliance routes / building zones.
AREA PLAN — Function scheme, depth 2, DISC-PROD-SEQ display. Functional zoning emphasis.
RCP — System scheme, depth 3, A+B+C+E sections. Distinguishes ceiling-fixture systems.
FOUNDATION — BOLD BLACK, Material scheme, depth 4. Concrete/rebar/steel callouts.
PLUMBING DRAINAGE — GREEN, System scheme, depth 3. Discipline convention.
ELECTRICAL POWER / LIGHTING / FIRE ALARM — ORANGE (high contrast vs yellow on white), System scheme. Riser uses Level scheme to track floor distribution.
PARTITION / SANITARY LAYOUT — depth 3, DISC-PROD-SEQ display. 1:50 detail layouts.
DETAIL — NOM 3.5mm, FullSpec preset, depth 5, all 6 A-F sections visible. Most-data-per-element drawings.
SECTION / ELEVATION — NOM, depth 3, full 8-segment, A+B+C sections. Standard production read.
PLANTROOM (1:50 dense MEP) — BOLD BLUE 3mm, System scheme, depth 5. Survives plantroom density.
HVAC DUCT PLAN — System scheme, depth 3. Air-system colour coding.
STANDARD PLAN (arch / struct / mep / elec / plumbing fallthrough) — NOM, Discipline-coloured, Discipline scheme, depth 3, full 8-segment. The default production read.

drawingTypes.name: Electrical Single Line Diagram — A1 NTS
drawingTypes.description: Electrical single line diagram (distribution hierarchy from the circuit model) on A1, not to scale. The view is the drafting view SLD_Generate draws at 1:1; SLD_Generate puts it on this type's sheet and replaces an earlier run's SLD there. Not produced per level.

drawingTypes.name: Lightning Protection Schematic — A1 NTS
drawingTypes.description: Lightning protection system schematic (BS EN 62305-3: air terminals, down conductors, earth electrodes, bonding) on A1, not to scale. The view is the drafting view LPS_Schematic draws at 1:1 from the ELC_LPS_* marked components; LPS_Schematic puts it on this type's sheet and replaces an earlier run's schematic there.

drawingTypes.name: Earthing Arrangement Schematic — A1 NTS

drawingTypes.name: Panel Door / Busbar Layout — A3 NTS
drawingTypes.description: Distribution board door / busbar interior layout (way positions, circuits, spares, earth bar) on A3, not to scale, one sheet per board. The view is the drafting view Panel_DoorDiagram draws at 1:1; Panel_DoorDiagram puts each board on its own sheet of this type.

drawingTypes.name: HVAC Pipework Layout — A1 @ 1:100

drawingTypes.name: HVAC Schematic — A1 NTS
drawingTypes.description: HVAC schematic (air-handling, CHW / LTHW principle) on A1, not to scale.

drawingTypes.name: Water Supply Layout — A1 @ 1:100

drawingTypes.name: Fire Protection Riser Schematic — A1 NTS
drawingTypes.description: Sprinkler / wet and dry riser schematic on A1, not to scale.

drawingTypes.name: MEP Section — A1 @ 1:50
drawingTypes.description: Building services section on A1 at 1:50: duct, pipe and tray levels through a corridor or riser.

drawingTypes.name: MEP Detail — A3 @ 1:20
drawingTypes.description: Building services detail on A3 at 1:20: plant connections, valve sets, supports.

drawingTypes.name: Lightning Protection Zones (rolling sphere) — A3
drawingTypes.description: Lightning protection zone diagram (BS EN 62305-3 rolling-sphere protection radius of each air terminal, drawn at its plan position) in the drafting view 'STING - LPS Protection Zones'. LPS_PlanVisualise draws and stamps the view; it is drawn in model coordinates, so a person sets its scale and places it on a sheet of this type.

drawingTypes.name: Arc Flash Labels (IEEE 1584-2018, indicative) — A1 NTS
drawingTypes.description: One indicative arc-flash label per calculated board (IEEE 1584-2018 incident energy, boundary, working distance, basis) on A1, not to scale. The view is the drafting view Elec_ArcFlashLabels draws at 1:1 from the last Arc Flash Calc; it puts the view on this type's sheet and replaces an earlier run's labels there. Not for specifying PPE without a licensed study.

drawingTypes.name: Arc Flash Schedule - A3
drawingTypes.description: Arc-flash schedule of electrical equipment (IEEE 1584-2018 incident energy, boundary, PPE category by energy, working distance, basis), indicative only. Elec_ArcFlashSched makes the ViewSchedule after Arc Flash Calc and puts it on this type's sheet; production emits the same schedule of category Electrical Equipment (unknown fields are skipped).
